title: A Sloth Risks Its Life Once a Week for This Strange Reason
subject: three-toed sloth

scenes.text: A sloth risks its life once a week, just for a bathroom trip.
It climbs down from the treetops to the forest floor, where it is easy prey.
The trip burns about eight percent of its energy budget.
So why not go from a branch? Because of moths that live in its fur.
Female moths lay eggs in the fresh dung. The adults fly up and settle back into the fur.
Those moths help algae grow in the fur, and the sloth eats the algae. The risky trip is a farm run.

description:
A three-toed sloth climbs down from the trees once a week, and it is risky.
Moths in its fur lay eggs in the dung, and they help algae grow in the sloth's fur, which it eats.
Would you take that risk for a snack?
